title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 38
paragraphs: Now the men of Mytilene, as soon as they got Coës into their hands, led him out and stoned him to death; but the men of Cyme let their tyrant go, and so too did most of the other cities. Thus were the tyrants deposed in the various cities; and Aristagoras the Milesian, having deposed the tyrants, bade each people appoint commanders in their several cities, and then himself set out as an envoy to Lacedaemon—for in truth it was necessary for him to find some powerful ally.
